# ANP campaigns: copy to <Dog Days folder>\ANP_campaign.txt to change a switch (no file = these defaults).
# Read once at game start by ANP_Loader.asi (loader/campaign.inc). 1 = on, 0 = off.

# Scene ids through the MSVCR90 strncpy import: Dead Men ids, the menu's DMCN / DGNW / DGCN, campaign mode.
Routing=1
# Old jmp patch at 0x6d100f (CEG-hashed code). Fallback only; switched on by itself if strncpy can't be hooked.
LegacyResolver=0
# Serve <DD>\ANP\ANP_Patch01.zip (tools/anp_menu.py) in place of Patch01.zip / KL2FixPatch01.zip.
Menu=1
# With Menu=1: menu/frontend.xml itself is served from <DD>\ANP\menu\frontend.xml (tools/anp_menu.py) through the
# file system object's vtable, whatever archive is mounted; the log says which copy the menu got.
MenuXml=1
# Dead Men / Dead Dogs saves go to %LOCALAPPDATA%\A Newer Perspective\saves\<DeadMen|DeadDogs>\.
SaveRedirect=1
# Back at the front end: Dog Days' profile is re-read from its own save (0 = keep the redirect for the session).
# If the re-read does not reach the save file, the redirect stays on for the session (Dog Days' save is protected).
ProfileReload=1
# Wait after the front end's last scene-zip open (plus 1 s of steady frames) before that re-read.
ReloadDelayMs=2000
# No Steam achievements while a Dead Men scene runs.
AchievementGuard=1
# %LOCALAPPDATA%\A Newer Perspective\ANP_progress.ini (Dead Men Continue, Dead Dogs saga position).
Progress=1
# Dead Dogs: after Dead Men's ending, start Dog Days (L00) in the same campaign.
DeadDogsHandover=1
# Log ExitProcess calls (0x8000dead = Valve CEG code-integrity check).
ExitTripwire=1
# New game / New saga play Dead Men's intro (<DD>\Movies\ANP\M00_Intro.bik, tools/anp_movie.py); when it ends or is
# skipped the loader starts M01 / the saga (BinkOpen/BinkClose import hooks). 0 = the page's fallback button only.
IntroMovie=1
# Wait after the movie closes before starting the scene.
IntroDelayMs=200
